## Engineering Task Shape Analysis — `gastownhall/gascity` @ `bd7c9dac`

This is a production Go CLI/daemon (`gc`) that orchestrates AI agent sessions, formula-driven workflows, and a custom bead-persistence layer (Beads + Dolt). The codebase is large (~100 internal packages), actively shipped (v1.4.0 released 2026-07-24), and exhibits evidence of every standard task shape, some in high concentration.

---

### 1. Feature

**The dominant shape at this revision.** Multiple independent subsystems were built from scratch or to a new-generation spec:

- **Run-centered dashboard and usage observability** — [`internal/usage/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/tree/internal/usage): new `Fact`/`Sink` abstraction (model tokens + compute wall-seconds), idempotency keys, local sink and exec sink. Described as "durable usage and lifecycle observability" in CHANGELOG §1.4.0.
- **Privacy-scoped command-usage metrics** — [`internal/productmetrics/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/tree/internal/productmetrics) and [`internal/commandcensus/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/tree/internal/commandcensus): a closed, schema-versioned manifest that statically classifies every `gc` subcommand with notice/recording/exclusion policies; a full disclosure flow; platform-specific spooling and upload. New feature with no legacy predecessor visible in the tree.
- **Convergence workflow engine** — [`internal/convergence/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/tree/internal/convergence): the 9-step `Handler.HandleWispClosed` state machine ([`handler.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/internal/convergence/handler.go)), trigger-gated loops (`transitionToWaitingTrigger`), speculative wisp pour-before-evaluate crash safety, manual approval paths. This is a self-contained new capability.
- **Formula v2 retry expansion** — [`internal/formula/retry.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/internal/formula/retry.go): `ApplyRetries` / `expandRetry` introduce control-bead / attempt-bead pairs as a first-class formula IR transformation.
- **OpenTelemetry operator telemetry** — [`internal/telemetry/telemetry.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/internal/telemetry/telemetry.go): new OTLP metrics + logs pipeline wired to VictoriaMetrics/Logs; `GC_OTEL_*` env contract; per-process `service.instance.id` for correct cumulative counting.
- **OpenClaw bridge proof of concept** — [`contrib/openclaw-bridge/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/tree/contrib/openclaw-bridge): iMessage/Telegram connectors, explicitly flagged as experimental.

---

### 2. Localized Bug Fix

Numerous targeted repairs, several with incident-number references:

- **Pool draining / claim fencing** — CHANGELOG §1.4.0 Fixed: "Pool sessions no longer lose or strand work while draining, restarting, or reusing capacity." Claim ownership, wake budgets, slot selection, and confirmed-dead cleanup are tightened.
- **Live run cost fields (`tokens/min`, `burn/hr`)** — `End-of-interval model-usage sweeps account for each transcript window once, restoring tokens/min and burn/hr in run detail (PR #4436)`.
- **Cross-city attention reads cancelling stale requests** — `#4354, #4356, #4361` cited in CHANGELOG for dashboard and claim regressions.
- **Dolt `idDefaultRepairTables` probe** — [`native_dolt_store.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/internal/beads/native_dolt_store.go?L19-L60): a precise fix for Dolt silently stripping `DEFAULT (uuid())` from `id` columns; replaced a full `INFORMATION_SCHEMA` catalog scan (which pegged CPU at scale) with a single `SHOW COLUMNS` probe. The inline comment references the incident: `ga-698fl2: a dev store silently reached 3,272 active beads / ~11MB of JSON / ~2s bd latency per cycle`.
- **Formula control routing transient-read retry** — CHANGELOG: "Attempt spawn and fan-out no longer quarantine an in-flight run because of a momentary config/include read failure."
- **`gc session logs --tail N` blank output** — CHANGELOG §1.3.0 Fixed: `tool_result: ok` and `(no displayable content)` fallbacks added.

---

### 3. Refactor

- **`StartupHints → runtime.Config` single projection point** — [`internal/agent/hints.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/internal/agent/hints.go): `ToRuntimeConfig()` is explicitly the "single source for the StartupHints → runtime.Config field mapping" so every consumer routes through one place instead of threading fields individually. The doc comment states the refactor intent explicitly.
- **Session lifecycle through the worker boundary** — CHANGELOG §1.4.0 Changed: pool demand, wake, resume, drain, close, and orphan recovery now reason from persisted session/work identity rather than provider-specific shortcuts. This is a behavioral consolidation across subsystems, not a new capability.
- **Control-dispatcher routing** — CHANGELOG §1.4.0 Upgrading Notes: formula control beads now route to the dispatcher whose `Dir` matches the city or rig store. The prior implicit fallback was removed, making the routing model explicit.
- **`controlAttemptStrategy` seam** — [`internal/dispatch/control.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/internal/dispatch/control.go?L49-L61): retry and ralph control loops share one attempt loop via a strategy struct, extracting the per-kind variation from the shared loop body.
- **`graphv2` package** — [`internal/graphv2/invocation.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/internal/graphv2/invocation.go): extracted from ad hoc inline logic; "centralizes graph.v2 input-convoy invocation rules" and explicitly deprecates `issue`/`bead_id` legacy variables.
- **Built-in pack composition** — CHANGELOG §1.3.0: `.gc/system/packs` materialization removed; gastown pack moved to `github.com/gastownhall/gascity-packs`; explicit pinned imports replace implicit built-ins.

---

### 4. Test Generation

Strong evidence of systematic, property-based, and oracle-driven test authorship rather than manual tests:

- [`internal/beads/caching_store_reconcile_generators_test.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/internal/beads/caching_store_reconcile_generators_test.go), [`caching_store_reconcile_oracle_test.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/internal/beads/caching_store_reconcile_oracle_test.go), [`caching_store_reconcile_probes_test.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/internal/beads/caching_store_reconcile_probes_test.go), [`caching_store_reconcile_decision_test.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/internal/beads/caching_store_reconcile_decision_test.go) — this suite is a dedicated oracle + property-based test cluster for the reconciler; `pgregory.net/rapid` (in `go.mod`) confirms rapid property testing is used.
- [`internal/beads/bdstore_storage_conformance_test.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/internal/beads/bdstore_storage_conformance_test.go), [`native_dolt_store_conformance_test.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/internal/beads/native_dolt_store_conformance_test.go) — cross-backend conformance suites run the same contract against multiple store implementations.
- [`internal/formulatest/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/tree/internal/formulatest) and [`internal/chartest/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/tree/internal/chartest) — dedicated test-helper packages, not production code.
- Release gate CI sharding — CHANGELOG §1.4.0 Changed: "CI and local verification are sharded and event-driven" covering fast units, process tests, integration packages, tutorials, inference acceptance, and macOS regressions; the `release-gates/` directory (200+ gate files) is the manifest of this system.

---

### 5. Dependency Migration

- **`modernc.org/sqlite` adoption** — [`go.mod:43`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/go.mod?L43): `modernc.org/sqlite v1.50.1` (pure-Go, CGO-free). Gate `ga-7z0hku-1-modernc-adoption-clean-gate.md` tracks it; `ga-mtgtv7-2-1-sqlite-cgo-cleanup-clean-gate.md` records the CGO cleanup. The `cgb4kj-sqlite-provider-removal-gate.md` shows a corresponding removal of the old SQLite provider.
- **`dolthub/dolt` pinned pre-release** — `go.mod:106`: `v0.40.5-0.20260605230755-1bf533220ab0`, referencing a bespoke fork pin. `ga-iwec-dolt-1862-floor-gate.md` shows version-floor enforcement.
- **`go-jose/go-jose/v4`** replacing `gopkg.in/go-jose/go-jose.v2` — both present in `go.mod` (v4 as direct, v2 as indirect), indicating an in-flight migration.
- **`gastown` pack** — moved from checked-in `examples/gastown/packs/gastown` to `github.com/gastownhall/gascity-packs v0.3.1` (CHANGELOG §1.3.0). This is a dependency externalization.

---

### 6. Documentation / Configuration

- **`CHANGELOG.md`** — rich, operator-facing, follows Keep a Changelog with upgrading notes as a first-class section. Evidence of deliberate documentation authorship.
- **`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `GEMINI.md`** — agent-context files at repo root; instructions for AI coding agents operating in this codebase.
- **`release-gates/`** (~200 Markdown gate files) — prose specs that serve as both CI gate definitions and living documentation of every shipped change.
- **`engdocs/`** directory — internal engineering documentation.
- **`renovate.json`** — automated dependency update configuration.
- **`taplo.toml`** — TOML formatter configuration.
- **`internal/rollout/`** — the `Flags`/`rollout` system is partly configuration-as-code: each gate is a named config key with typed resolution, rollout notices, and a `ForTest` injection point. [`flag_daemon_formula_v2.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/internal/rollout/flag_daemon_formula_v2.go) is a representative example.

---

### 7. Boilerplate

- **`testenv_import_test.go`** files — present in every package (`internal/agent/`, `internal/beads/`, `internal/convergence/`, `internal/formula/`, `internal/usage/`, etc.). These are uniform, zero-logic import-side-effect files that wire the package into a shared test environment. Pure boilerplate, repeated identically across ~30+ packages.
- **`internal/productmetrics/command_ids_gen.go`** — a generated file (note `_gen.go` suffix), produced by `cmd/gen-command-census/`. Generated registration boilerplate.
- **`schemas_embed.go`** at repo root — a generated `//go:embed` registration file for JSON schemas.

---

### 8. Architectural Scaffolding

- **`internal/beads/` store abstraction** — `Store` interface, `CachingStore`, `NativeDoltStore`, `MemStore`, `FileStore`, `DoltLiteReadStore`, `ClassStore`, `LibStore` all implement a shared contract. The conformance tests (`bdstore_storage_conformance_test.go`) are the scaffolding's integrity mechanism. The `factory.go` file composes these behind a single entry point. This is a multi-layer persistence architecture with explicit degradation semantics.
- **`internal/rollout/` gate registry** — `Registry`, `Resolve`, `Flags`, typed gate accessors, `ForTest` injection — a complete feature-flag infrastructure designed so new gates can be added without modifying the resolution core.
- **`internal/commandcensus/` manifest + validator** — `Manifest`, `ValidateManifest`, `DecodeManifest`, strict JSON decoding with duplicate-key rejection, tombstone/ID-allocation invariants. The schema is self-describing and self-enforcing; adding a new command is a structured, validated operation rather than a free-form edit.
- **`internal/agent/hints.go` `StartupHints`** — the struct serves as an explicit cross-cutting data contract between config resolution and runtime. Its `ToRuntimeConfig()` is documented as "the single source" for that mapping, ensuring new hint fields propagate everywhere.
- **`internal/convergence/handler.go` `Store` interface** — a narrow, test-injectable interface over the bead store for the convergence handler. This is scaffolding: the handler is testable independently of any real store, and adding a new convergence step only requires implementing the interface.

---

### 9. Cleanup

- **`hqstore` removal** — `ga-syvdua-hqstore-removal-gate.md` and `ga-iiziq3-coordstore-benchmark-removal-gate.md` indicate a whole backend implementation was retired.
- **Fallback agent removal** — CHANGELOG §1.3.0: "Fallback agents were removed." Packs that relied on a fallback `dog/worker` must now ship their own. A cross-pack name collision is now a hard error.
- **Named session alias cleanup** — CHANGELOG §1.3.0: `gc doctor --fix` drops the stale `[[named_session]]` alias written by older builds.
- **`sqlite` CGO path cleanup** — gate `ga-mtgtv7-2-1-sqlite-cgo-cleanup-clean-gate.md` and `ga-cgb4kj-sqlite-provider-removal-gate.md`.
- **Legacy `issue`/`bead_id` variable deprecation** — [`graphv2/invocation.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/internal/graphv2/invocation.go?L33-L38): `LegacyIssueVar` and `legacyBeadIDVar` explicitly marked deprecated with a one-release compat shim.
- **`setmetadata` cleanup** — `ga-jqvmde-3-setmetadata-clean-gate.md`.
- **Dolt test DB prefix cleanup** — `ga-m3gz4-dolt-cleanup-test-db-prefixes-gate.md`.

---

### Taxonomy Notes / Ambiguity

| Observed case | Ambiguity |
|---|---|
| `internal/rollout/` flag system | Spans **architectural scaffolding** (the registry/resolver) and **configuration** (per-flag files). Split is defensible; not ambiguous at the file level. |
| Release gate `.md` files | Could be classified as **documentation** (prose spec) or **configuration** (CI gate definition). They are both simultaneously. |
| `testenv_import_test.go` files | The existing taxonomy handles these as **boilerplate** cleanly. No new category needed. |
| `contrib/openclaw-bridge/` | Marked experimental by CHANGELOG; could be **architectural scaffolding** (bridge pattern, not shipped), **feature** (new connector surface), or **boilerplate** (connector skeleton). The CHANGELOG itself calls it a "proof of concept" — **architectural scaffolding** is the most accurate label. |

**No taxonomy refinement is proposed.** All observed work fits the provided categories, including cases that span two (the gate files). The only structural observation worth noting: this codebase exhibits an unusually high ratio of **architectural scaffolding** work relative to most projects — the store abstraction, rollout registry, command census, and convergence handler interface are all purpose-built extension seams, not incidental abstractions. If the taxonomy were applied at the *commit* level rather than the repository level, "scaffolding" commits would form a recognizable cluster distinct from pure feature work.

- [`internal/beads/bdstore_storage_conformance_test.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/internal/beads/bdstore_storage_conformance_test.go), [`native_dolt_store_conformance_test.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/internal/beads/native_dolt_store_conformance_test.go) — cross-backend conformance suites run the same contract against multiple store implementations.
- [`internal/formulatest/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/tree/internal/formulatest) and [`internal/chartest/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/tree/internal/chartest) — dedicated test-helper packages, not production code.
- Release gate CI sharding — CHANGELOG §1.4.0 Changed: "CI and local verification are sharded and event-driven" covering fast units, process tests, integration packages, tutorials, inference acceptance, and macOS regressions; the `release-gates/` directory (200+ gate files) is the manifest of this system.

---

### 5. Dependency Migration

- **`modernc.org/sqlite` adoption** — [`go.mod:43`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/go.mod?L43): `modernc.org/sqlite v1.50.1` (pure-Go, CGO-free). Gate `ga-7z0hku-1-modernc-adoption-clean-gate.md` tracks it; `ga-mtgtv7-2-1-sqlite-cgo-cleanup-clean-gate.md` records the CGO cleanup. The `cgb4kj-sqlite-provider-removal-gate.md` shows a corresponding removal of the old SQLite provider.
- **`dolthub/dolt` pinned pre-release** — `go.mod:106`: `v0.40.5-0.20260605230755-1bf533220ab0`, referencing a bespoke fork pin. `ga-iwec-dolt-1862-floor-gate.md` shows version-floor enforcement.
- **`go-jose/go-jose/v4`** replacing `gopkg.in/go-jose/go-jose.v2` — both present in `go.mod` (v4 as direct, v2 as indirect), indicating an in-flight migration.
- **`gastown` pack** — moved from checked-in `examples/gastown/packs/gastown` to `github.com/gastownhall/gascity-packs v0.3.1` (CHANGELOG §1.3.0). This is a dependency externalization.

---

### 6. Documentation / Configuration

- **`CHANGELOG.md`** — rich, operator-facing, follows Keep a Changelog with upgrading notes as a first-class section. Evidence of deliberate documentation authorship.
- **`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `GEMINI.md`** — agent-context files at repo root; instructions for AI coding agents operating in this codebase.
- **`release-gates/`** (~200 Markdown gate files) — prose specs that serve as both CI gate definitions and living documentation of every shipped change.
- **`engdocs/`** directory — internal engineering documentation.
- **`renovate.json`** — automated dependency update configuration.
- **`taplo.toml`** — TOML formatter configuration.
- **`internal/rollout/`** — the `Flags`/`rollout` system is partly configuration-as-code: each gate is a named config key with typed resolution, rollout notices, and a `ForTest` injection point. [`flag_daemon_formula_v2.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/internal/rollout/flag_daemon_formula_v2.go) is a representative example.

---

### 7. Boilerplate

- **`testenv_import_test.go`** files — present in every package (`internal/agent/`, `internal/beads/`, `internal/convergence/`, `internal/formula/`, `internal/usage/`, etc.). These are uniform, zero-logic import-side-effect files that wire the package into a shared test environment. Pure boilerplate, repeated identically across ~30+ packages.
- **`internal/productmetrics/command_ids_gen.go`** — a generated file (note `_gen.go` suffix), produced by `cmd/gen-command-census/`. Generated registration boilerplate.
- **`schemas_embed.go`** at repo root — a generated `//go:embed` registration file for JSON schemas.

---

### 8. Architectural Scaffolding

- **`internal/beads/` store abstraction** — `Store` interface, `CachingStore`, `NativeDoltStore`, `MemStore`, `FileStore`, `DoltLiteReadStore`, `ClassStore`, `LibStore` all implement a shared contract. The conformance tests (`bdstore_storage_conformance_test.go`) are the scaffolding's integrity mechanism. The `factory.go` file composes these behind a single entry point. This is a multi-layer persistence architecture with explicit degradation semantics.
- **`internal/rollout/` gate registry** — `Registry`, `Resolve`, `Flags`, typed gate accessors, `ForTest` injection — a complete feature-flag infrastructure designed so new gates can be added without modifying the resolution core.
- **`internal/commandcensus/` manifest + validator** — `Manifest`, `ValidateManifest`, `DecodeManifest`, strict JSON decoding with duplicate-key rejection, tombstone/ID-allocation invariants. The schema is self-describing and self-enforcing; adding a new command is a structured, validated operation rather than a free-form edit.
- **`internal/agent/hints.go` `StartupHints`** — the struct serves as an explicit cross-cutting data contract between config resolution and runtime. Its `ToRuntimeConfig()` is documented as "the single source" for that mapping, ensuring new hint fields propagate everywhere.
- **`internal/convergence/handler.go` `Store` interface** — a narrow, test-injectable interface over the bead store for the convergence handler. This is scaffolding: the handler is testable independently of any real store, and adding a new convergence step only requires implementing the interface.

---

### 9. Cleanup

- **`hqstore` removal** — `ga-syvdua-hqstore-removal-gate.md` and `ga-iiziq3-coordstore-benchmark-removal-gate.md` indicate a whole backend implementation was retired.
- **Fallback agent removal** — CHANGELOG §1.3.0: "Fallback agents were removed." Packs that relied on a fallback `dog/worker` must now ship their own. A cross-pack name collision is now a hard error.
- **Named session alias cleanup** — CHANGELOG §1.3.0: `gc doctor --fix` drops the stale `[[named_session]]` alias written by older builds.
- **`sqlite` CGO path cleanup** — gate `ga-mtgtv7-2-1-sqlite-cgo-cleanup-clean-gate.md` and `ga-cgb4kj-sqlite-provider-removal-gate.md`.
- **Legacy `issue`/`bead_id` variable deprecation** — [`graphv2/invocation.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-gascity@bd7c9dac0b305b94893f3382f66cb129536d1be4/-/blob/internal/graphv2/invocation.go?L33-L38): `LegacyIssueVar` and `legacyBeadIDVar` explicitly marked deprecated with a one-release compat shim.
- **`setmetadata` cleanup** — `ga-jqvmde-3-setmetadata-clean-gate.md`.
- **Dolt test DB prefix cleanup** — `ga-m3gz4-dolt-cleanup-test-db-prefixes-gate.md`.

---

### Taxonomy Notes / Ambiguity

| Observed case | Ambiguity |
|---|---|
| `internal/rollout/` flag system | Spans **architectural scaffolding** (the registry/resolver) and **configuration** (per-flag files). Split is defensible; not ambiguous at the file level. |
| Release gate `.md` files | Could be classified as **documentation** (prose spec) or **configuration** (CI gate definition). They are both simultaneously. |
| `testenv_import_test.go` files | The existing taxonomy handles these as **boilerplate** cleanly. No new category needed. |
| `contrib/openclaw-bridge/` | Marked experimental by CHANGELOG; could be **architectural scaffolding** (bridge pattern, not shipped), **feature** (new connector surface), or **boilerplate** (connector skeleton). The CHANGELOG itself calls it a "proof of concept" — **architectural scaffolding** is the most accurate label. |

**No taxonomy refinement is proposed.** All observed work fits the provided categories, including cases that span two (the gate files). The only structural observation worth noting: this codebase exhibits an unusually high ratio of **architectural scaffolding** work relative to most projects — the store abstraction, rollout registry, command census, and convergence handler interface are all purpose-built extension seams, not incidental abstractions. If the taxonomy were applied at the *commit* level rather than the repository level, "scaffolding" commits would form a recognizable cluster distinct from pure feature work.
